verses.en: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
verses.pt: Toda alma esteja sujeita às autoridades superiores; porque não há autoridade que não venha de Deus; e as que existem foram ordenadas por Deus.
verses.en_web: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
verses.en_bbe: Let everyone put himself under the authority of the higher powers, because there is no power which is not of God, and all powers are ordered by God.

verses.en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
verses.pt: Por isso quem resiste à autoridade resiste à ordenação de Deus; e os que resistem trarão sobre si mesmos a condenação.
verses.en_web: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
verses.en_bbe: For which reason everyone who puts himself against the authority puts himself against the order of God: and those who are against it will get punishment for themselves.

verses.en: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
verses.pt: Porque os magistrados não são motivo de temor para os que fazem o bem, mas para os que fazem o mal. Queres tu, pois, não temer a autoridade? Faze o bem, e terás louvor dela;
verses.en_web: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,
verses.en_bbe: For rulers are not a cause of fear to the good work but to the evil. If you would have no fear of the authority, do good and you will have praise;

verses.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
verses.pt: porquanto ela é ministro de Deus para teu bem. Mas, se fizeres o mal, teme, pois não traz debalde a espada; porque é ministro de Deus, e vingador em ira contra aquele que pratica o mal.
verses.en_web: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
verses.en_bbe: For he is the servant of God to you for good. But if you do evil, have fear; for the sword is not in his hand for nothing: he is God's servant, making God's punishment come on the evil-doer.

verses.en: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
verses.pt: Pelo que é necessário que lhe estejais sujeitos, não somente por causa da ira, mas também por causa da consciência.
verses.en_web: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
verses.en_bbe: So put yourselves under the authority, not for fear of wrath, but because you have the knowledge of what is right.

verses.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
verses.pt: Por esta razão também pagais tributo; porque são ministros de Deus, para atenderem a isso mesmo.
verses.en_web: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, attending continually on this very thing.
verses.en_bbe: For the same reason, make payment of taxes; because the authority is God's servant, to take care of such things at all times.

verses.en: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
verses.pt: Dai a cada um o que lhe é devido: a quem tributo, tributo; a quem imposto, imposto; a quem temor, temor; a quem honra, honra.
verses.en_web: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
verses.en_bbe: Give to all what is their right: taxes to him whose they are, payment to him whose right it is, fear to whom fear, honour to whom honour is to be given.

verses.en: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verses.pt: A ninguém devais coisa alguma, senão o amor recíproco; pois quem ama ao próximo tem cumprido a lei.
verses.en_web: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
verses.en_bbe: Be in debt for nothing, but to have love for one another: for he who has love for his neighbour has kept all the law.

verses.en: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.pt: Com efeito: Não adulterarás; não matarás; não furtarás; não cobiçarás; e se há algum outro mandamento, tudo nesta palavra se resume: Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
verses.en_web: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.en_bbe: And this, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not put to death, Do not take what is another's, Do not have desire for what is another's, and if there is any other order, it is covered by this word, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

verses.en: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.pt: O amor não faz mal ao próximo. De modo que o amor é o cumprimento da lei.
verses.en_web: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
verses.en_bbe: Love does no wrong to his neighbour, so love makes the law complete.

verses.en: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verses.pt: E isso fazei, conhecendo o tempo, que já é hora de despertardes do sono; porque a nossa salvação está agora mais perto de nós do que quando nos tornamos crentes.
verses.en_web: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
verses.en_bbe: See then that the time has come for you to be awake from sleep: for now is your salvation nearer than when you first had faith.

verses.en: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
verses.pt: A noite é passada, e o dia é chegado; dispamo-nos, pois, das obras das trevas, e vistamo-nos das armas da luz.
verses.en_web: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
verses.en_bbe: The night is far gone, and the day is near: so let us put off the works of the dark, arming ourselves with light,

verses.en: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
verses.pt: Andemos honestamente, como de dia: não em glutonarias e bebedeiras, não em impudicícias e dissoluções, não em contendas e inveja.
verses.en_web: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
verses.en_bbe: With right behaviour as in the day; not in pleasure-making and drinking, not in bad company and unclean behaviour, not in fighting and envy.

verses.en: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
verses.pt: Mas revesti-vos do Senhor Jesus Cristo; e não tenhais cuidado da carne em suas concupiscências.
verses.en_web: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
verses.en_bbe: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not give thought to the flesh to do its desires.
